phases: manual resolution (out of scope for C12)

dual_read.note: compute both keys, decide on the legacy one

dual_write.note: needs a new column; divergence risk if a writer is missed

shadow_index.note: parallel unique index on the proposed key surfaces conflicts before any row changes

transaction_boundaries.note: one batch per transaction; index build must be CONCURRENTLY, outside the transaction

locking_availability.note: CONCURRENTLY avoids long locks; chunked batch updates

atomicity_risk.statement: Changing stored canonical values without atomically changing the application comparison logic makes scans and uniqueness checks disagree.
atomicity_risk.consequence: barcodes may stop resolving and duplicate aliases may slip through unnoticed
atomicity_risk.mitigation: dual-read first, then recompute and switch comparison logic in the SAME release
